title: Old Church of Our Lady Mary of Zion
axis: Positive Z faces the west-southwest approach to the cathedral. Positive X follows the façade toward the south-southeast.

features.role: Named surviving cathedral outline used for the historical exterior.

identityStatus: OpenStreetMap locates the older church envelope south of the new cathedral. The modern standing footprint controls registration. Published archaeological measurements inform the surrounding podium and stair.

terrainContact.basis: Unmodified Copernicus GLO-30 near the foot of the west stairs. The foundation and stair base continue below sampled ground.

notes: The 1893 view published in Bent shows three square portico openings, raised corner details and a low crenellated roof. Archaeological sources date the later arches and pitched roof to 1908.
